book.spectrum.guidebook.shimmerstone.pag:
A vibrant amber-tinted ore that not only emits energy in the form of light, but can also manipulate it.\
\
I found Shimmerstone Ore mainly in deep caves of soft stone near the coast, or near the surface in volcanic rock where the magma of aons ago imparts in them a cozy warmth.
book.spectrum.guidebook.stratine.page0.t:
This very heavy ore is scattered throughout the depths of metamorphosed regions.\
It is probably not the best idea to carry large amounts of it home at once.
The pale blue color is the hallmark of this ore, found exclusively in high up clusters in grand igneous mountain ranges.\
\
The curious properties of this material are not to be overlooked.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ashen_circlet.pa:
The [Stratine Gem](entry://general/stratine) I set in this circlet, itself a creation of blaze and hellfire, can absorb high temperatures with ease.\
It even protects me from the searing heat of Lava – if only for a short time.\
\
When combined with [#](449900)Fire Resistance[#](), I can swim in Lava almost as if it were Water.
These hostile underwater caves are hell to maneuver in. Coincidentally, I stumbled upon a [#](bb00bb)Heart of The Sea[#]().\
This circlet I built with it allows me to live underwater as if it were the most natural thing in the world. I mine and swim faster, require no air and can see better.\
\
It also heals my little close by Axolotl friends. ♥
book.spectrum.guidebook.lava_sponge.page:
When I held a [](item://minecraft:wet_sponge) in my hands, I thought naturally there must be a counterpart for [#](bb00bb)Lava[#](), too. Although I haven't stumbled upon one yet, that hasn't stopped me from inventing one.\
\
This should make navigating the depths of the world much easier.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ender_glass.page:
I felt from the moment I put the recipe on paper that this creation was going to be something special.\
\
The combination of [#](449900)the Ender[#](), [#](449900)Redstone[#]() and [#](449900)Magic[#]() gives it very strange properties.

To make it even stranger, the material seems to respond to the last signal applied, not the strongest.\
\
Truly a curiosity from another world.
book.spectrum.guidebook.lucky_roll.page0:
Will I become a pastry chef on top of my main job as an artist? These don't even look too bad (taste good too!).\
\
Composed of [Amaranth Flour](entry://cuisine/amaranth) (or any substitutes!), [](item://minecraft:sugar), [Milk](item://spectrum:clotted_cream), and a [Four-Leafed Clover](entry://general/clover), I noticed a very special effect: I was a little bit more successful handling tools with Fortune, Looting and other random-based things.
Even if it initially did not look as if its the case: The mountains holds secrets comparable to the depths.
I saw an ore high up in grand old igneous mountains, sometimes generating exposed to air, so a hike may be my best bet. It has both a common and a rare drop.
book.spectrum.guidebook.inexorable.page0:
I've come a long way and there are few things that can still stop me, except for mining fatigue, slowness, mining underwater, when I am flying in the air and other adverse conditions...\
\
*Hm, written out like this, that was a bit more than expected*.
I recently completed a painting, showing a fantastic creature that has appeared in my dreams: apparently made of [#](bb00bb)Soul Sand[#]() and [#](bb00bb)Wither Skeleton Skulls[#](). I experimented for hours, trying to recreate it, only to nearly lose my own head while searching for a Wither Skeleton with a spine loose enough to drop its skull.
book.spectrum.guidebook.clovers_favor.pa:
Increased chance of getting rare loot drops.\
*May even increase my chances of getting the most valuable of all drops?*\
\
Max Level: 3\
Applicable to melee weapons.\
Mutually exclusive with Looting.
book.spectrum.guidebook.crystallarieum.p:
[#](449900)Metallic resources[#]() require unrefined materials such as [#](bb00bb)Copper Ingot[#](), resulting in a [#](bb00bb)Copper Bud[#]() that will grow steadily until it can be safely harvested.\
\
For [#](449900)crystalline resources[#](), an existing crystal can be used as a seed to grow identical copies of itself.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.radiating_: Some Endermen appear to carry blocks that could very well be small relics of their powers. At first I thought it was Cobblestone and it very much looks like that placed down, but if I could get one by killing an Enderman while it is still carrying it, I can get ahold of one. Endermen holding these blocks can also be found in the Wound, albeit more rarely.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.quitoxic_r: Time for an adventure trip on the surface. Somewhere wet and warm such as the sub-tropics seem predestined for new botanical discoveries!
book.spectrum.guidebook.block_variants.p:
The application of a chisel emphasizes their light and dark textures even more.\
The Greywacke turns almost black. They can be crafted into a wide variety of decorative blocks using the [](item://minecraft:crafting_table) or [](item://minecraft:stonecutter).
book.spectrum.guidebook.trifles.page0.te:
Sweet delicacies, guaranteed to give me more than just a sugar rush – depending on the toppings.\
Made from [Jaramel](entry://general/jade_vines@jaramel), [#](449900)Gelatin[#]() & [Amaranth](entry://cuisine/amaranth) (or any substitutes!).\
\
*Even the simple one tastes great!*
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.shimmersto: As my understanding of the world has expanded, so has my ability to perceive anomalies. I believe I saw a yet unknown yellow ore in volcanic regions or in coastal regions of soft rock.
It generates in large deposits near the surface in sedimentary and igneous extrusive rocks. Its most common in volcanic regions, as sedimentary rocks only go deep enough underground near the coast.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.stratine.p: I remember seeing blotches of red in the lowest depths of the world.
It almost looked like an ore, a dense, red mineral in deep down metamorphic rock. It has a common and a rare drop.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.azurite.pa: In some areas around magma I noticed a striking blue aura. I wonder what causes it.
These auras, accompanied by soft humming, seem to be caused by giant deposits of rich blue ore! It is buried within volcanic rock in rare, but giant clusters.
book.spectrum.guidebook.ideas.preservati: A collegue's mining expedition had them find a structure of unbreakable stone underground, its not too far but not too close from the surface. Perhaps there are more?
book.spectrum.guidebook.shale_clay.page4: Looks like farmland, tastes like farmland, but is poorly suited for use as such.
book.spectrum.guidebook.slush.page1.text: Ever-moist farmland, unspecialized roots decay and break down. Unfortunate.
